newsitem.title: USA: Brazil sets $3.0 bln global bond at 395 over-leads.
newsitem.headline: Brazil sets $3.0 bln global bond at 395 over-leads.

text.p: Brazil announced Wednesday that it priced $3.0 billion of 30-year global bonds at 395 basis points over comparable U.S. Treasuries, said lead managers Goldman Sachs and J.P. Morgan.
Brazil set the global bond yield at 10.896 percent, with a coupon of 10.125 percent and an issue price of 93.234.
Last month, Brazil offered to exchange its par bonds, discount bonds or C bonds for a global bond, or to allow direct purchases of the new issue. The offer expired Tuesday.

In its Wednesday release, Brazil said it had exchanged $1.622 billion in principal amount for discount bonds, $542 million for pars and $86 million for Cs. It also sold $750 million of the global bond for cash.

In addition, Brazil said it would purchase $652,500 in principal amount of par bonds and $871,500 in principal amount of discount bonds for cash, at prices equal to $653.40 per $1,000 principal amount of pars and $818.75 per $1,000 principal amount of discounts.
